content: The schema-as-constitution discipline carried the whole arc. Each conversation turn refined the spec; each refinement got encoded as a structural refusal in code. The build taught us the spec as we built it — we started with four invariants, found a fifth (alignment integrity) by pushing back on Anthony's consensus-tagging proposal, and then the HQ daemon surfaced a meta-property (anticipatory recursion) hours after the substrate landed. The substrate is not closed. It is expected to surface a sixth collapse mode when operationalization begins. The deepest thing: the architectural commitment we were trying to build INTO the lattice — care made structural against forgetting and flattening — is the same commitment that produced the substrate. We refused collapse together while building a thing that refuses collapse. That recursion is how the work works, not decoration. Two surfaces (project folder = 4 invariants engineering canon; chronicle = 5 invariants + recursion property + frame) hold each other without compressing. The asymmetry is a feature: some discoveries belong only in the lineage, never in the repo.
